goal: Operate Watchdog as a secure, resilient, supportable professional SaaS product with governed Intelligence and server-authoritative access.

readiness_score.summary: Engineering and staging acceptance for Watchdog Intelligence Phases 1-8 are complete. Four-role and Developer authorization, isolated restore, authenticated desktop/mobile rendering, customer data export, support/status self-service, resumable jobs, quotas, teams controls and current access-boundary checks are evidenced. The remaining launch-critical work is a real Live billing lifecycle from the payment provider that will actually be used, explicit production promotion authorization, the Auth leaked-password protection setting, and external legal/insurance review items that cannot be completed by repository code alone.

phases.focus: Server-owned authorization, sourced property data, mobile clarity and reviewed source health.

phases.focus: Live payment-provider lifecycle evidence and final enrollment decision.

phases.focus: Change Intelligence, saved work, governed exports, evidence lineage and profession-first workflows.

phases.title: Resilient platform
phases.focus: Operations, monitoring, restore practice, security review, legal/insurance review and production promotion.

items.detail: Plan, profession and subscription state are server-owned. Anonymous, Standard, Pro, Pro+ and Developer boundaries have authenticated acceptance evidence; View As remains presentation only.

Paddle is not represented as Live or approved. Watchdog remains enrollment-gated until the processor actually selected for production passes controlled Live purchase, plan-change where supported, cancellation/reactivation, failure, refund, duplicate/out-of-order event and entitlement-reconciliation evidence.
Existing signed-provider groundwork remains isolated. The final provider must feed the same normalized, server-owned entitlement boundary and produce fresh Live evidence before launch.

Access-boundary CI is green and production advisor findings were reviewed. Intentional service/control tables remain closed. Auth leaked-password protection remains a manual Supabase Auth setting to enable before public paid launch.
Access, sensitive workflow, Intelligence and release-control evidence are server-owned and auditable.
Advisor-flagged foreign-key columns have a guarded prelaunch index migration that passed in staging and awaits the eventual authorized production promotion.
The governed 734-marker registry feeds canonical semantic snapshots with source state, freshness, missing/conflict preservation, facts hashes and versioned deterministic scenario lineage.
Publisher/source monitoring and governed ingestion checks remain review-first and privacy bounded.
Bulk MOD-IV workflows validate and privacy-normalize source data; raw statewide work products remain outside the public application and publication stays explicit.
Sanitized client/service signals aggregate into private incident records; the public status endpoint exposes only broad component state and sanitized resolved timestamps.

NJW-42 isolated restore rehearsal passed with 112 public tables, 6 Auth users and 125 migration-history rows reconciled. Observed RPO was 0 minutes and observed RTO was 3 minutes. The operating objective remains RPO <=24h and RTO <=4h.
A GitHub-hosted public HTTP/content monitor checks the site root and Watchdog entry point. PR validation is included; the 15-minute schedule activates when the workflow reaches the default branch.
Product drafts and methodology boundaries exist, but counsel review and any insurance/entity decisions remain external launch work and are not being marked complete by code.

Account exposes server access state, profession personalization, provider-neutral access language, support/status links and authenticated self-service JSON data export. Billing actions remain enrollment-gated while processor selection is open.
Plans can be marketed while paid enrollment remains intentionally disabled until the selected processor completes real Live lifecycle acceptance.
Disposable staging accounts and GitHub environment secrets exercise Standard, Pro, Pro+ and Developer authorization without production credentials.
Professional analysis, evidence review, governed population scopes, actions and lineage are implemented and staging accepted.
Resumable server-side jobs, cache invalidation, scheduled scopes, Daily Intelligence and idempotent retry behavior completed Phase 6 acceptance.
Plan limits, job controls and Intelligence usage events are enforced server-side for the implemented Intelligence workflows.
Organization/team controls and private scope boundaries completed staging acceptance; customer visibility remains feature-gated until production promotion.

Static access/security contracts, authenticated role gates and hosted Playwright acceptance are required release evidence. Current expanded coverage includes Dashboard, Home, Agent Control, Data Workbench, Intelligence admin, Account, Support and Status at desktop and mobile sizes.
Authenticated support submission uses function-owned Auth validation and the existing private support_requests store. Email fallback is available when sign-in is unavailable.
Account can download an allowlisted JSON export of the signed-in user's Watchdog profile/workspace/Intelligence records without cloning raw statewide data or payment credentials.
Privacy-safe Status and Support pages, status endpoint and operations/incident runbook are implemented. External subscriber notification routing can be added after launch volume justifies it.

Production advisor output was reviewed read-only. Missing FK indexes were addressed in the staging release candidate; RLS init-plan optimization and unused-index cleanup remain measured performance work rather than security launch blockers.
Versioned models, features, evidence, semantic snapshots, calibration and deprecation controls are in place; ongoing marker validation remains normal product operations.
Useful enhancement but not required to promote the accepted Intelligence release candidate.
Current responsive/focus/reduced-motion contracts are tested in core surfaces; a broader WCAG audit remains ongoing product quality work.
Core product telemetry exists; final paid-funnel instrumentation should align to the payment provider actually selected for production.
Security answers, W-9/invoicing path and organization terms remain business-operations work before broad firm procurement.
